text: Good morning, Central New Jersey. The weather service has a Coastal Flood Warning for parts of the area, so check it before you head out. Watch for a crash or incident at US 206 northbound (2.5 mi away). It's 48°F, Sunny, up to 48°. Watch for frost or slick spots early.

weatherAlerts.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued November 24 at 2:30PM EST until November 27 at 3:00AM EST by NWS Mount Holly NJ
weatherAlerts.instruction: A Coastal Flood Warning means that moderate or major tidal flooding is occurring or imminent. Be prepared for rising water levels and take appropriate action to protect life and property. Follow the recommendations of local emergency management officials. weatherAlerts.headline: High Wind Warning issued November 24 at 1:51PM EST until November 27 at 1:00AM EST by NWS Mount Holly NJ
weatherAlerts.instruction: People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around or damaged by the wind.

weatherAlerts.headline: High Wind Watch issued November 24 at 1:51PM EST until November 27 at 1:00AM EST by NWS Mount Holly NJ
weatherAlerts.instruction: Monitor the latest forecasts and warnings for updates. Fasten loose objects or shelter objects in a safe location prior to the onset of winds.

weatherAlerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 24 at 1:11PM EST until November 27 at 5:00AM EST by NWS Upton NY
weatherAlerts.instruction: Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high profile vehicles. Use extra caution. Secure outdoor objects.
